summary: Motorenwerk Saalach GmbH, group-owned motor maker (650 staff) refocusing on key accounts; we are 0.63 % of its turnover and now 'not strategic'. We pay it 19.4 days late on average (90 % of invoices over 5 days late) and it threatened to review conditions. It quotes list conditions, stock supply only. Quality is excellent. Price is 2.6 % over its should-cost; sup:70510 is qualified for its 30 kW motor. Offer on-time payment; keep demands modest.
notes: Needs on-time payment; it fears being tied to a small, late-paying account. Our grievance is self-inflicted. Its quality is excellent (0 ppm, OTD 92-100 %, 1 complaint in 3 years), so quality arguments backfire. 'Supply from stock only' hints it may cut service. Spend grew 28 %, yet it still calls us not strategic.
